veranderings.voor: weggevee of hou hulle in toom
veranderings.na: weggevee, of dit hou hulle in toom
veranderings.rede: The second verb shifts tense without its own subject; repeating the subject makes the two options read as two clear clauses and needs the AWS comma before 'of'.

veranderings.voor: ruimte met die asteroïdes ver van mekaar af
veranderings.na: ruimte, en die asteroïdes is ver van mekaar af
veranderings.rede: The 'met ... ver van mekaar af' construction follows English 'with the asteroids far apart'; a second clause is more natural Afrikaans, and the protected wording before it stays intact.
Parallel with 'Ons noem hulle die rotsagtige planete' in the same block; the protected word 'gasplanete' is unchanged.
